# SSAC27 full paper — E25, a second and larger identity-linkage audit of the unverified estimation pairs

**Status: exploratory, and a second look** (Amendment 5, `docs/research/sloan-full-paper-preregistration-amendment-5-2026-11-12.md`, commit `be615140b`). Generated by `scripts/sloan_fullpaper_linkage_audit_e25.py`; rendered by `scripts/report_sloan_fullpaper_linkage_audit_e25.py` from `docs/research/artifacts/sloan-fullpaper-linkage-audit-e25-2026-11/`. The first audit (E13) is `docs/research/sloan-fullpaper-linkage-audit-2026-11-04.md`; its result stands unchanged.

## In plain words

The league factors are estimated from 4,074 player pairs joined by name. 1,537 were verified one by one; 2,537 were not. The first audit (E13) checked 100 of those and classed 1 as wrong, which left an upper bound of 5.4%, just above the registered 5% bar. E25 drew a fresh random sample of 300 pairs from the 2,437 that E13 had not drawn (seed 20261112), wrote the list down before reading any record, and applied the E13 checks and rules unchanged.

**Result.** 4 of 300 new pairs are classed as wrong: **1.3%, Wilson 95% interval 0.5% to 3.4%**. 296 are confirmed and 0 are unresolved. Pooled with E13: 5 of 400, 1.25%, interval 0.5% to 2.9%.

**The registered bound is earned.** The upper bound is below 5% on the new sample alone (3.4%) and on the pooled sample (2.9%). The paper may say: "at most 3.4% of unverified estimation pairs are identity mismatches" (the larger bound, rounded up), with the E13 result beside it. The point estimate is below 10%, so this is not a data-quality finding that must go to Amir before writing. There is no third look: the audit is not extended again for this paper.

**What the 4 WRONG pairs are.** 2 are contradicted by club or schedule records. 2 are WRONG only because the two sources give different birthdates while the club and schedule checks agree; the rule was fixed in advance, so they stay WRONG. The split is descriptive and carries no licence.

## Specification

| Choice | This analysis | Alternative printed |
|---|---|---|
| **Unit** | one factor-estimation pair: player × season, his domestic (source) record and his continental (destination) record | — |
| **Population (frame)** | the E13 frame (pool-A pairs absent from verified pool B, 2,537) minus the 100 pairs drawn in E13: **2,437 pairs** | — |
| **Sample** | 300 pairs, simple random sample without replacement, `numpy.random.default_rng(20261112)`, frame in the E13 order; keys written before any record was read | redraw with seed 20261113 (negative control) |
| **Estimator** | share of audited pairs classed WRONG, on the new sample, and pooled with the E13 sample | the E13 sample alone; the bound with UNRESOLVED counted as WRONG |
| **Null** | none (a rate with an interval) | — |
| **Filter** | none beyond the frame; every drawn pair is classed, none dropped or replaced | — |
| **Key** | `player_name × season × league_src × league_dest` (the E13 key) | — |
| **Uncertainty** | Wilson 95% interval for the WRONG share | UNRESOLVED share always printed |

| E13 (first look, unchanged) | 100 | 99 | 1 | 0 | 1.00% | 0.2% to 5.4% | 5.4% |
| E25 (new sample) | 300 | 296 | 4 | 0 | 1.33% | 0.5% to 3.4% | 3.4% |

Rule-based classes on the new sample, before hand review: CONFIRMED 296, WRONG 4, UNRESOLVED 0. Hand review may only decide rule-UNRESOLVED pairs; there were none, so the committed hand-review file is empty and the final classes are the rule classes.

| Check on the new sample | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Normalised name | agrees 300 |
| Birthdate, where both sides carry one | agrees 24, contradicts 3, not_available 273 |
| Club consistency | agrees 298, contradicts 2 |
| Schedule feasibility | feasible 299, infeasible 1 |

Both sides carry a birthdate for 27 of the 300 pairs. As in E13, most confirmations rest on name plus club, not on a birthdate match.

| Third look | none allowed, whatever the result | not taken |

## What this does not show

* **It is a second look.** E25 exists because E13 narrowly missed the bar. The new sample was drawn fresh and passes on its own, which is the control registered for that; the pooled figure is printed beside it, not instead of it.
* **A bound on the rule-based WRONG share, not a census.** The other pairs of the frame were not checked.
* **Mostly name plus club.** Only 27 of 300 pairs carry a birthdate on both sides; a CONFIRMED pair without one rests on the club and schedule checks.
* **Estimation pairs only.** E25 audits the pairs behind the translation factors. It does not audit the 674 forecast arrivals, which are joined by the same name key.
* **No factor was re-estimated.** The WRONG pairs stay in the pinned factor pools; no paper number changes except the linkage sentence.
